Hi Elaine / Vertex procurement team,

Quick note as your Outreach renewal window approaches in October — we'd like to make sure the renewal is smooth and also surface a fallback option in case Outreach's terms or timelines don't align with Vertex's procurement constraints. High level ask: can you confirm the following by next Wednesday (08/27)?

- Renewal term desired (12 vs 24 months)
- Target start date and any procurement approval cycles we should know about
- Any required vendor attestations (SSO/SCIM, SOC 2 summary, subprocessor list)

I've looped in Priyom (sales ops) to capture the technical/security asks and to model a contingency plan if Outreach pricing/lead times require us to evaluate Salesloft as a fallback. Priyom — once Vertex confirms timeline, can you run a quick license delta (per-rep seat + migration hours) and estimate cost/breakage for a 30-day migration pilot?

Attachments: Vertex_Renewal_Term_Request.pdf (form they sent last week)

Thanks — short on time here so appreciate quick turns.

Hi Camila / Priyom,

Thanks — apologies for the delay. We are targeting a 12-month renewal starting 2025-11-01. Procurement review runs the first two weeks of October; final PO issued by 10/20 if approvals go smoothly.

We do need the following before vendor approval:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- Subprocessor list (including data residency details)
- SCIM/SSO integration docs and expected lead time for SSO enablement

If Outreach can provide those within the week (by 08/29) that will keep us on-track. If not, we'll need to evaluate alternatives to avoid a gap in our seller tooling.

Also please send us the most recent SOW and a line-item quote (seats + onboarding).

Camila — forwarding Elaine's reply. A couple of quick items from my side after a first-pass assessment:

Summary of ask from Vertex: SOC2, subprocessors, SCIM/SSO docs, SOW + quote. Outreach typically provides SOC2 and subprocessors within 48 hours, SCIM docs are public but SSO enablement for a new tenant takes 5-10 business days once we submit the request.

Contingency plan (high level) if Outreach cannot meet timeline or pricing:
- Option A: Short-term extension with seat-level credits (ask Outreach for a 30-day bridge at current rates)
- Option B: Pilot Salesloft for up to 25 seats for 30 days; expected migration effort ~40 hours engineering + 24 hours admin + training (~$8k services)
- Option C: Freeze new seat activations and stagger onboarding to reduce license delta for 2 quarters

Open questions for Marissa/Ben (cc'd) — can Legal/Finance support a short-term extension credit (Option A) if Outreach proposes it? Also need a services estimate if Vertex prefers us to run migration (Option B).

Attached: Outreach-quote-VA-20250822.xlsx (vendor quote from prior renewal cycle), SOW-Outreach-VA-2025.pdf (example SOW)

Ben/Marissa — quick internal follow-up before I respond to Elaine (copying procurement timeline above). Two asks:

1) Finance / Credits: Ben, can you confirm if we have precedent for a 30-day bridged credit for renewals where vendor delivery lag causes procurement delays? If so, what level of credit (percent of monthly run-rate) was typical? I need a short talking point to negotiate with Outreach if they ask to push SSO/attestations out a week.

2) Professional Services estimate: Marissa, the 40h engineering + 24h admin estimate from Priyom sounds reasonable — please give me a ballpark $ number (with two bands: expedited vs standard). If we run the migration, we should propose an accelerated 3-week engagement at premium rates.

I'll wait for both numbers and then send a consolidated reply to Elaine with: requested artifacts, suggested timeline, and two contingency options (bridge credit OR short pilot + migration SOW).

Thanks — small, direct bullets appreciated.
